documents.title: The Bargain
documents.text: Her closest friend sold their plan to the enemy in exchange for gold. Mira watched the departing rider, unaware of the bargain.

documents.title: The Photograph
documents.text: At the funeral, Mira held her mother's photograph and wept beside the grave. The room slowly emptied around her.

documents.title: The Grate
documents.text: The prisoner broke free through a loose grate and fled across the courtyard. Behind him, the cell door slammed.

documents.title: The Register
documents.text: Under a false name, Pavel entered the inn and signed the register. He pulled his collar high before anyone could recognize him.

documents.title: Market Day
documents.text: The baker arranged warm loaves on the counter. Children counted apples while a cart rattled along the street.

documents.title: Weather Station
documents.text: Rain swept across the harbor. Thunder echoed over the empty quay as the keeper checked the instruments.
